Which part of the plant makes seeds?

lesson.title: How Each Plant Part Keeps It Alive
lesson.description: Discover the special job of roots, stem, leaves and flowers through a farm visit.
learningObjectives: Explain the function of roots, stem, leaves and flowers
lesson.content:
Imagine you are walking through a farm early in the morning. A tall {{term:maize}} plant stands in the soil. It does not have hands or a mouth, yet it eats, drinks and grows. Each part of the plant has a job that keeps the whole plant alive.

You can see this for yourself at home. Put a {{example:celery}} stalk into a glass of water with a few drops of food colouring. Leave it for some hours. The coloured water moves up the stem and reaches the leaves. This shows how the stem carries water from the roots to the whole plant.
